methodological_classification.rationale: Under formal biostatistical guidelines (TRIPOD+AI, SPIRIT-AI), a cohort that is repeatedly evaluated to compare architectures and benchmark iterative milestones cannot be certified as a pristine blind test set. Architectural decisions in Phase 5B (selecting Cross-Attention over Concatenation) were validated against this cohort. Although gradient descent and early stopping strictly used the 64 validation patients (val_loss), repeated evaluation risks subtle adaptive selection. Therefore, the 65 patients must be transparently classified as an iterative benchmark/evaluation cohort.

independent_cohort_availability.remedy_required_for_pristine_testing: To achieve pristine blind testing, an entirely new, unpartitioned clinical cohort of paired biplanar radiographs and volumetric CT scans must be acquired from an independent external institution.

audit_verdict.summary: No gradient leakage or weight-fitting on test data occurred; however, the test cohort functioned as an iterative benchmark rather than a pristine blind test cohort.
